mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates and boosts forward returns, as lower financing costs increase corporate valuation multiples over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS declining over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp monthly, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO < 115.0) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signal a supply-driven economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances meeting INDPRO < 115.0 and UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior 6 months signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth over 6 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (y/y), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate an active monetary tightening cycle that raises discount rates and compresses earnings multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 350000) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 2000) indicate a demand-driven economic expansion that boosts corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances meeting RSAFS > 350000 and HOUST > 2000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
